findings.description: q-126765 grades its sine-argument blank as one exact antiderivative although the scaffold adds arbitrary C. At h=3, x^2-6*x and (x-3)^2+1 describe the same local solution family as stored (x-3)^2, but native grading rejects both before and after delivery. The author preflight incorrectly expects stored-key+1 to be rejected for this family.
